meta.repo: personal-site (local folder, not a git checkout)

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. The site defaults to Night.

tokens.name: bg-1
tokens.usage: Raised surface: project and paper cards, chips, the theme toggle track.

tokens.name: bg-2
tokens.usage: Hover fill for nav links and ghost buttons; tooltips.

tokens.name: bg-inset
tokens.usage: Inset frames: figures, the resume frame, slider thumb ring.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on bg.

tokens.name: fg-1
tokens.usage: Body prose, excerpts, secondary copy.

tokens.name: fg-2
tokens.usage: Muted text: mono labels, dates, bylines, captions (6.7:1 Night, 4.8:1 Paper on bg).

tokens.name: fg-3
tokens.usage: Faintest text: project indices, footer fine print, arrows. Below 4.5:1 in both themes (3.6 Night, 2.7 Paper) — keep it to non-essential text or icons.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Default card, chip and frame border.

tokens.name: border-faint
tokens.usage: Hairline section and list dividers, nav bottom edge.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Ghost button outline, hovered card border, range track.

tokens.name: grid-line
tokens.usage: The faint 64px instrument grid behind the page, fading out by 60% height.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The active accent. Default is Mono: ink on paper, following the theme. Primary buttons, active toggle, eyebrow tick, blockquote rule, drop cap. Swapped for a hue via data-accent.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover (Mono).

tokens.name: accent-fg
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (Mono).

tokens.name: accent-line
tokens.usage: Accent-tinted borders and link underlines (Mono).

tokens.name: accent-quiet
tokens.usage: Accent-tinted fills: accent chips, text selection (Mono).

tokens.name: accent-teal
tokens.usage: Teal accent option (also the CSS :root fallback). Same value in both themes: 6.8:1 on Night bg, only 2.7:1 on Paper bg — fine as a fill under accent-teal-fg, not as body text on Paper.

tokens.name: accent-teal-hover
tokens.usage: Teal accent hover.

tokens.name: accent-teal-fg
tokens.usage: Text on a teal fill (6.7:1).

tokens.name: accent-amber
tokens.usage: Amber accent option. 7.5:1 on Night bg, 2.5:1 on Paper bg — fill only on Paper.

tokens.name: accent-amber-hover
tokens.usage: Amber accent hover.

tokens.name: accent-amber-fg
tokens.usage: Text on an amber fill (7.3:1).

tokens.name: accent-iris
tokens.usage: Iris accent option. 6.1:1 on Night bg, 3.0:1 on Paper bg — fill only on Paper.

tokens.name: accent-iris-hover
tokens.usage: Iris accent hover.

tokens.name: accent-iris-fg
tokens.usage: Text on an iris fill (6.2:1).

tokens.name: accent-sky
tokens.usage: Sky accent option. 6.3:1 on Night bg, 2.9:1 on Paper bg — fill only on Paper.

tokens.name: accent-sky-hover
tokens.usage: Sky accent hover.

tokens.name: accent-sky-fg
tokens.usage: Text on a sky fill (6.2:1).

tokens.name: accent-coral
tokens.usage: Coral accent. Defined in colors_and_type.css but not offered in the accent picker.

tokens.name: accent-coral-hover
tokens.usage: Coral accent hover.

tokens.name: accent-coral-fg
tokens.usage: Text on a coral fill.

tokens.name: essay-warn
tokens.usage: The one signal colour: conflicts and warnings inside essay figures (sudoku cells, notes). 7.6:1 Night, 4.7:1 Paper.

families.serif: ui-serif, Georgia, Cambria, "Times New Roman", Times, serif

styles.name: hero-name
styles.usage: Masthead name. Fluid in code: clamp(2.6rem, 6.5vw, 4.4rem); an <em> inside takes the accent, italic.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page and post titles (.obs-h1, .post-title). Fluid: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 3.2rem).

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Section heads (--t-h2). Fluid: clamp(1.7rem, 2.8vw, 2.35rem). Line height not set in code; 1.2 assumed from .obs-h2.

styles.name: entry-title
styles.usage: Writing-list entry titles; turn accent on hover.

styles.name: pull-quote
styles.usage: Blockquote: 2px accent rule on the left, fg.

styles.name: essay-body
styles.usage: Long-form essay body, on the 38rem measure.

styles.name: prose
styles.usage: Standard prose (.obs-prose) in fg-1; paragraphs spaced by space-5.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Base body text and UI copy.

styles.name: nav-link
styles.usage: Nav links (--t-small); the active one gets a 1.5px accent underline.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase instrument labels (--t-label, --tracking-label) in fg-2; the eyebrow adds an 18px accent tick before it.

styles.name: chip
styles.usage: Uppercase topic chips, dates, bylines, footer links.

tokens.name: sp-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps: venue lines, small meta.

tokens.name: sp-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in buttons and eyebrows; chip rows.

tokens.name: sp-3
tokens.usage: Gap between hero actions, brand mark and name.

tokens.name: sp-4
tokens.usage: Section-head bottom padding, small stacks.

tokens.name: sp-5
tokens.usage: Space between prose paragraphs.

tokens.name: sp-6
tokens.usage: Grid gaps for project and focus cards; blockquote indent.

tokens.name: sp-8
tokens.usage: Page side padding, card padding, timeline row padding.

tokens.name: sp-10
tokens.usage: Space above in-prose h2.

tokens.name: sp-12
tokens.usage: Figure margins, meta strip gap.

tokens.name: sp-16
tokens.usage: Section vertical padding.

tokens.name: sp-20
tokens.usage: Defined; not used in kit.css.

tokens.name: sp-24
tokens.usage: Masthead top padding, post bottom padding.

tokens.name: r-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, image frames, small controls.

tokens.name: r-lg
tokens.usage: Defined equal to r-sm. Large cards and frames hard-code 16px in kit.css instead.

tokens.name: r-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, theme toggle, accent toggle.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: The only elevation: hovered project cards, the resume frame, tooltips.

tokens.name: glow-accent
tokens.usage: Soft accent ring on the range slider thumb (Mono values).

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the page container and nav.

tokens.name: measure-wide
tokens.usage: Post headers, figures, about lead.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Reading measure for prose and essay bodies.

tokens.name: nav-h
tokens.usage: Sticky nav height.
